question: tell the top 5 customers and then tell the top 5 regions by revenue and then tell the top 5 products that are most returnabe
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: tell the top 5 customers and then tell the top 5 regions by revenue and then tell the top 5 products that are most returnabe
sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: tell the top 5 customers and then tell the top 5 regions by revenue and then tell the top 5 products that are most returnabe
sql:
SELECT
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    COUNT(r.id) AS return_count
FROM returns r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE r.return_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' 
  AND r.return_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY return_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: generate a monthly report for january month covering sales, product details, marketing, orders, return
generate a monthly report for january month covering sales, product details, marketing, orders, return
sql:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' 
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-02-01'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id;
